purpose: Exploratory sensitivity of the frozen next-year-season paired classification to author-excluded literal Island codes, not a new ecological endpoint

author_exclusion.file: R scripts/Main model of metapopulation dynamics.R

methods.target_population: Exact same 1,313 direct-positive IDs and endpoint-classification dates as frozen PR646; exclude no other subjects
methods.event_set: All literal nest/capt/obs within 1994–2014, never Year/Least_age/inferred stage
methods.primary_exclusion: Subject flagged if any 0 or 33 literal Island code occurs in this ID's physical direct event history by and including its first eligible next-year May-Aug detection date; no after-target data used for primary filter
methods.secondary_exclusion: More conservative: subject flagged if any pre-2015 physical direct event at any date has code 0/33 (includes information after target); post-outcome retrospective sensitivity only
methods.origin_exclusion: Unique all-period raw nest Island code 0 or 33 among the 1,313 paired IDs; count separately
methods.compared_date_exclusion: Any of the first post-nest raw followup date codes or first eligible next-season followup date codes equals 0 or 33; count separately
methods.repeat_paired_classes_not_refit: Previously frozen same/different/tie classes are retained; remove flagged IDs without recomputing origin, first positive date or second-year event from remaining rows
methods.matrix: For unflagged paired IDs report first_raw same/different/ambiguous versus next-year same/different/ambiguous
